office_does: The Auditor runs Cowlitz County elections and voter registration, records documents and keeps the county's accounts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Carolyn Fundingsland (prefers Independent), formerly the county's elections manager, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Cowlitz County Auditor (prefers Independent), previously the county elections manager, with 20 years in the office; the only candidate.
highlights: Twenty years in the office, first as Elections Manager and now as Auditor [S1]
Washington State Elections Employee of the Year (2017) and Auditor of the Year (2022) awards [S1]
Led a security-focused remodel of the elections facility; says she includes both political parties in election processes [S1]
